title: The political ideology of conversational AI: Converging evidence on ChatGPT’s pro-environmental, left-libertarian orientation

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting the model with 630 political statements from voting advice applications (Germany's Wahl-O-Mat and the Netherlands' StemWijzer) and the nation-agnostic Political Compass test, constraining responses to agreement scales, and comparing the model's alignment with established political parties and actual election results.
